propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale local mirror of the ticket store (refs/heads/tickets) when fetch=False, causing show_ticket to return outdated ticket state (status, comments) that contradicts the live store

The close path pins the ticket store via close_precheck with fetch=False, threading the flag into materialize_tickets which skips fetching origin/tickets and uses an arbitrarily stale local branch mirror as authoritative

The fenced context given to the LLM model comes from the live store but show_ticket reads the pinned stale snapshot, creating disagreement between untrusted_ticket_context and the authoritative show_ticket result that model correctly trusts

A non-PASS completion verdict with empty findings is fabricated into a placeholder criterion (unspecified) rather than surfaced as a verifier fault, leaving operators unable to distinguish parse failures from genuine unmet criteria

Two independent tickets (wailsome-unsure-asianlion, fixable-angular-caribou) were blocked by stale snapshots: one reported false ticket state and zero comments, the other reported evidence budget starvation when comments were invisible to the verifier
